rationale: Builds on the frozen 9x512 reverse recurrent-tail best while keeping its final evaluator, serialization, quant-aware endgame, data paths, and print formats intact. The only training-path change is to route value_and_grad through a compile-stable train_loss that keeps all tokens supervised but upweights the final eval_stride positions, matching the official sliding-window scoring context better than uniform loss. The wrapper also fixes masked_loss accumulation for chunked logits and avoids recursive state/best_script imports if it becomes the saved best.
title: Tail-Position Weighted Training Loss
